info.title: EdgePress Tenant API
info.description: Per-tenant CMS API. Authenticate every request with a personal access token: `Authorization: Bearer epat_...`. Create + manage tokens at `/admin/settings/api-tokens`.

tenant.description: Your tenant hostname (subdomain of edgepress.cc or a custom domain).

shopperSession.name: __Host-shop_session
shopperSession.description: Shopper session cookie (store tenants only). Set by POST /api/shop/login. For storefront browsers — PATs cannot obtain or use it. State-changing shopper requests must also echo the __Host-shop_csrf cookie's token in X-CSRF-Token.

cartToken.name: __Host-shop_cart
cartToken.description: Anonymous guest-cart token (store tenants only). Minted (HttpOnly, 256-bit CSPRNG) by the first guest POST /api/shop/cart. A bearer credential for that one cart on that one store — it never authenticates a shopper. Signed-in requests ignore it: a __Host-shop_session cookie always binds cart operations to the customer instead.

operationName.description: Operation to run when the document holds more than one.

GraphQLResponse.description: GraphQL envelope. Status is 200 even for failures — inspect `errors`.

publishedVersion.description: JSON snapshot of the template row taken at publish time

blockType.description: One of the types listed by GET /api/blocks

slug.description: Optional; generated from `name` when omitted. Must be unique across templates (409 on duplicate).

isDefault.description: true unsets any other default template of the same type

UpdateTemplateRequest.description: All fields optional; only supplied fields are updated.

slug.description: Must stay unique across templates (409 on duplicate)
Optional; generated from `name` when omitted. Must be unique within the template (409 on duplicate).

UpdateZoneRequest.description: All fields optional; only supplied fields are updated.

slug.description: Must stay unique within the template (409 on duplicate)

config.description: Validated against the block type's JSON Schema; violations return 400 with `validationErrors`

PatchBlockRequest.description: All fields optional; only supplied fields are updated. `config` keys are shallow-MERGED into the stored config, not a replacement.

config.description: Top-level keys merged into the stored config; the merged result is re-validated against the block type's JSON Schema

ReorderRequest.description: Array order becomes orderIndex 0..n. Pass `zoneIds` when reordering zones, `blockIds` when reordering blocks.

templateId.description: Template id to assign, or `null` to unassign (removes the page's template).

StoreCategory.description: A store catalogue category. Categories form a tree via parent_id; deleting a parent detaches its children (parent_id becomes null).

StoreProduct.description: A store catalogue product. price and compare_at_price are integer minor units in the product currency (1999 = 19.99). Category membership is stored in a join table; the single-product GET returns it as `categories`, an array of category ids.

price.description: Integer minor units. Never a float.

images.description: JSON array of image URLs, as a string.

StoreOrder.description: A store order (slice 3a: read-only; status transitions arrive in a later release). Money fields are integer minor units in the order's own currency — totals are what was charged at checkout and are never re-derived from live product rows. customer_id and customer_email are null for guest orders; email/name are the contact details captured on the order itself at checkout; phone is copied from the shopper's account at checkout time — guest checkout collects no phone, so it is null on guest orders.

customer_id.description: Null for guest checkout, or when the customer account was later deleted.

customer_email.description: The linked customer account's current email; null for guest orders.

email.description: Contact email captured on the order at checkout.

currency.description: 3-letter uppercase ISO 4217 code, fixed at checkout.

total.description: Integer minor units. What was actually charged; never recomputed from live prices.

StoreOrderItem.description: A line item, rendered from its purchase-time snapshot: name and unit_price are what was sold at what price, immune to later product edits. product_id is null when the product was deleted after the sale.

unit_price.description: Integer minor units, snapshotted at purchase time.

StoreSettings.description: The store's configuration: exactly these 15 fields, nothing else (id, slug and user_id are never exposed here). The tax fields (tax_enabled, tax_rate, tax_inclusive) and the analytics ids (google_analytics_id, facebook_pixel_id) are STORED but not yet applied: tax is applied at checkout in slices 3–4 and analytics are emitted by the storefront in slice 6 — do not report them as live behaviour.

tax_enabled.description: Stored only in this release; tax is applied at checkout (slices 3-4).

tax_rate.description: Percentage, 0-100. Stored only in this release; applied at checkout (slices 3-4).

tax_inclusive.description: Stored only in this release; applied at checkout (slices 3-4).

google_analytics_id.description: Stored only in this release; emitted by the storefront in slice 6.

facebook_pixel_id.description: Stored only in this release; emitted by the storefront in slice 6.

id.description: null when the owner has no cart yet.

subtotal.description: Integer minor units (1999 = 19.99). Sum of available lines only.

price.description: The LIVE product price in integer minor units — a cart re-reads the catalogue; only a placed order snapshots prices (CD6). Deliberately not named unit_price: that name is the add-time snapshot column, which this field does not mirror.

available.description: false when the line cannot be sold as-is — product archived, hidden, re-listed in a currency other than the cart's, or priced past the money ceiling. The line stays visible but is excluded from subtotal.

InvalidToken.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked token.

ReadOnlyToken.description: Token is read-only; only GET/HEAD are permitted.

get.description: Catalogue of the 20 block types this tenant can place in a template: `type`, `name`, `category` and `schemaUrl`. Public — no token required.

The block type's JSON Schema with every `$ref` inlined, so it needs no second fetch. Every field the block accepts, its default and its `x-group` (the admin editor generates its form from this document). Config sent to `createBlockInstance` / `updateBlockInstance` is validated against it. Public — no token required. Answers 404 `unknown_block_type` for a type with no registered schema, which also means that type's config is stored unvalidated.
Read-only GraphQL: pass `query` and `variables` as query-string parameters. Mutations must use POST. Same schema as POST — see there for the Template/Zone/Block operations.

getTemplate.summary: Read one template with its zones and blocks

createZone.summary: Add a zone to a template

createBlockInstance.summary: Put a block in a zone (config follows the block's schema)

publishTemplate.summary: Publish a template, then assign it to a page

assignTemplateToPage.summary: Assign a template to a page

post.description:
Templates, Zones and Block instances are managed here — this endpoint is the write API for page structure. REST covers content (posts, pages, media, settings); the template tree is GraphQL.

Auth is identical to the REST endpoints: `Authorization: Bearer epat_...`. A read-only token gets 403 on any mutation, and every mutation additionally requires the `editor` role or higher — an `author`/`columnist`/`contributor` caller gets a `FORBIDDEN` GraphQL error (`editor role required`). Queries are unaffected. Reachable at both `/api/graphql` and `/api/v1/graphql` (same handler). GraphQL always answers 200 — check the `errors` array, not the status code.

**Queries**
- `templates(type: TemplateType, isBaseLayout: Boolean, limit: Int, offset: Int)`
- `template(id: ID, slug: String)` — includes `zones { blocks }`, `blocks`, `inheritedBlocks`
- `blockTypes(category: BlockCategory, isActive: Boolean)` / `blockType(type: String!)` — same catalogue as `GET /api/blocks` and `GET /api/blocks/{type}/schema`
- `themeTokens` — same payload as `GET /api/theme/tokens`
- Content reads, usable WITHOUT a token (the middleware allow-lists non-mutation documents naming them): `page`, `pages`, `post`, `posts`, `category`, `categories`, `tag`, `tags`, `search`, `searchSuggestions`, and the render previews `renderedHome`, `renderedPage`, `renderedPost`, `renderedPostArchive`, `renderedCategory`, `renderedTag` — the last group returns a template's blocks as the site would render them, which is how an agent checks its work without publishing a page

**Template mutations**
- `createTemplate(input: CreateTemplateInput!)` — `name`, `slug`, `type` (`PAGE|POST|ARCHIVE|HOME|ERROR|CUSTOM`), optional `description`, `isDefault`, `isBaseLayout`, `parentTemplateId`, `thumbnail`, `config`
- `updateTemplate(id, input: UpdateTemplateInput!)` — same fields, all optional, plus `status`
- `deleteTemplate(id)` → Boolean
- `publishTemplate(id)` / `revertTemplate(id)` — draft ⇄ published
- `setDefaultTemplate(id)` — makes it the default for its type
- `copyTemplate(id, input: { name, parentTemplateId })`
- `assignTemplateToPage(pageId, templateId)` / `assignTemplateToPost(postId, templateId)`

**Zone mutations**
- `createZone(input: { templateId!, name!, slug!, description, maxBlocks, orderIndex, config })`
- `updateZone(id, input: UpdateZoneInput!)`
- `deleteZone(id)` → Boolean
- `reorderZones(templateId, zoneIds: [ID!]!)` — array order becomes `orderIndex` 0..n

**Block-instance mutations**
- `createBlockInstance(input: { templateId, pageId, postId, zoneSlug!, blockType!, orderIndex, config!, visibility, isActive })` — the config is validated against that block's `GET /api/blocks/{type}/schema` — all 20 block types have one — and a violation is rejected with `extensions.code = "invalid_config"` plus a `validationErrors` array. Schema defaults are applied at render time, so the stored config is exactly what you sent
- `updateBlockInstance(id, input: UpdateBlockInstanceInput!)` — `config` REPLACES the stored object rather than merging into it, and is validated as a whole (so it must still carry the schema's `required` fields). Read the block, merge, send it back
- `deleteBlockInstance(id)` → Boolean
- `reorderBlockInstances(zoneSlug, blockIds: [ID!]!)` — reorders by id; note the returned list is every block sharing that zone slug, not only the current template's

**Typical agent flow:** `blockTypes` → `createTemplate` → `createZone` (per region) → `createBlockInstance` (per block, config from the block schema) → `reorderBlockInstances` → `publishTemplate` → `assignTemplateToPage`.

get.description: The caller's own user row (never includes credential columns), plus `readOnly` — true when authenticating with a read-only PAT — and `authMethod` (`pat` or `session`). Use it as the first call of a session to learn your role and whether the token may write. Both products serve this call under /api/v1 (GET /api/v1/users/me) and answer with `product`, so one request identifies any tenant; this bare /api path is CMS-only.

product.description: Which EdgePress product this tenant runs: "cms" (absent also means cms) or "store".

get.description: List templates, default templates first then newest first. REST façade over the GraphQL `templates` query.

post.description: Create a template. Requires role editor or above; a lower-privileged token gets 403. Slug is generated from the name when omitted; a duplicate slug returns 409.

400.description: Bad request — a required field (`name`, `type`) is missing, or a field is invalid

403.description: Requires the editor role or above. Read-only tokens and tokens for lower-privileged users are refused.

409.description: A template with that slug already exists

get.description: Fetch one template with its `zones` inlined, and each zone's `blocks` inlined too (REST has no field selection).

patch.description: Update a template; only the supplied fields change. Requires role editor or above; a lower-privileged token gets 403. Changing the slug to one already in use returns 409.

403.description: Requires the editor role or above. Read-only tokens and tokens for lower-privileged users are refused.

409.description: A template with that slug already exists

delete.description: Delete a template. Requires role editor or above; a lower-privileged token gets 403. Unlike zone and block deletes, this is NOT idempotent: an unknown id returns 404, and a default template cannot be deleted (set another template as default first).

403.description: Requires the editor role or above. Read-only tokens and tokens for lower-privileged users are refused.

409.description: The template is the default for its type; set another template as default first

post.description: Publish the template: sets status to `published`, stamps `publishedAt`, and snapshots the template row into `publishedVersion`. The commit point of the build chain. Requires role editor or above; a lower-privileged token gets 403.

403.description: Requires the editor role or above. Read-only tokens and tokens for lower-privileged users are refused.

get.description: List the template's zones, ordered by orderIndex.

post.description: Create a zone in this template. Requires role editor or above; a lower-privileged token gets 403. `templateId` comes from the path — a templateId in the body is ignored. Slug is generated from the name when omitted; a slug already used in this template returns 409.

403.description: Requires the editor role or above. Read-only tokens and tokens for lower-privileged users are refused.

409.description: A zone with that slug already exists

post.description: Reorder the template's zones: body `{"zoneIds": [...]}`; array order becomes orderIndex 0..n. Ids not belonging to this template are ignored. Returns the template's zones in their new order. Requires role editor or above; a lower-privileged token gets 403.

400.description: zoneIds must be an array of zone ids

403.description: Requires the editor role or above. Read-only tokens and tokens for lower-privileged users are refused.

patch.description: Update a zone; only the supplied fields change. Requires role editor or above; a lower-privileged token gets 403. Changing the slug to one already used in the same template returns 409.

403.description: Requires the editor role or above. Read-only tokens and tokens for lower-privileged users are refused.

409.description: A zone with that slug already exists

delete.description: Delete a zone and every block in it (prevents orphan data). Requires role editor or above; a lower-privileged token gets 403. Idempotent: an unknown id still returns 204, not 404.

204.description: Deleted (or already absent — deletes are idempotent)

403.description: Requires the editor role or above. Read-only tokens and tokens for lower-privileged users are refused.

get.description: List the template's block instances. `?zone=<slug>` filters to one zone.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: Filter to blocks in this zone slug

post.description: Add a block instance to a zone of this template. Requires role editor or above; a lower-privileged token gets 403. `templateId` comes from the path — a templateId in the body is ignored. `config` is validated against the block type's JSON Schema; a violation returns 400 with `validationErrors`. An unknown `blockType` returns 404.

400.description: Invalid block config: the merged/submitted config violates the block type's JSON Schema. Body carries `validationErrors`.

403.description: Requires the editor role or above. Read-only tokens and tokens for lower-privileged users are refused.

patch.description: Update a block instance; only the supplied fields change. Requires role editor or above; a lower-privileged token gets 403. `config` is MERGED into the stored config — incoming top-level keys overwrite or add to what is stored, and keys you omit are kept. This deliberately diverges from the GraphQL `updateBlockInstance` mutation, which REPLACES the whole config object. The merge is SHALLOW (top-level keys only): a nested object you pass replaces the entire stored nested object at that key. The merged result is re-validated against the block type's JSON Schema; a violation returns 400 with `validationErrors`.

400.description: Invalid block config: the merged/submitted config violates the block type's JSON Schema. Body carries `validationErrors`.

403.description: Requires the editor role or above. Read-only tokens and tokens for lower-privileged users are refused.

delete.description: Delete a block instance. Requires role editor or above; a lower-privileged token gets 403. Idempotent, matching zone deletes: an unknown id still returns 204, not 404.

204.description: Deleted (or already absent — deletes are idempotent)

403.description: Requires the editor role or above. Read-only tokens and tokens for lower-privileged users are refused.

post.description: Reorder the blocks in one zone of this template: body `{"blockIds": [...]}`; array order becomes orderIndex 0..n. Returns only this template's blocks in the zone, in their new order. Requires role editor or above; a lower-privileged token gets 403.

400.description: blockIds must be an array of block ids

403.description: Requires the editor role or above. Read-only tokens and tokens for lower-privileged users are refused.

put.description: Assign (or replace) the template the page renders with; send `templateId: null` to unassign. Requires role editor or above; a lower-privileged token gets 403. Returns the updated page. 404 when the page or the template does not exist.

403.description: Requires the editor role or above. Read-only tokens and tokens for lower-privileged users are refused.

get.description: The store tenant’s public profile. Served by store tenants, not CMS tenants. No authentication. Store tenants also serve GET /api/v1/users/me (the uniform product-discovery call, PAT auth) and the authenticated catalogue API under /api/v1/categories and /api/v1/products (same Bearer scheme as the CMS); no cart, order or payment APIs exist yet. Shopper account endpoints (register/login/logout/me) live under /api/shop — cookie-authenticated, for storefront browsers, not PATs.

product.description: Always "store" — confirms the tenant runs the store product.

503.description: Store not yet provisioned — still identifies the tenant as a store

post.description: Create a shopper account on a store tenant (storefront surface, cookie world — not for PATs). Returns the same generic success whether the email was fresh or already registered, so registration cannot be used to enumerate customer emails. Does NOT start a session; call /api/shop/login next. Rate limited per IP.

password.description: Min 8 chars with upper, lower and digit.

200.description: Generic success — identical for fresh and duplicate emails.

400.description: Validation failure (bad email, weak password, unknown field).

post.description: Shopper sign-in. Sets the __Host-shop_session (HttpOnly) and __Host-shop_csrf cookies. If a __Host-shop_cart guest-cart token rides along, that guest cart merges into the customer's cart on this store (same product sums quantities, capped at 999; products in only one cart carry over) and the __Host-shop_cart cookie is expired — the guest token is invalidated. Cross-site POSTs (mismatched Origin header) are rejected with 403 before anything else. Every credential failure mode — unknown email, wrong password, disabled account — returns one identical 401. Rate limited per IP and per (email, IP); sustained failure returns 429 before credentials are checked.

200.description: Signed in; __Host-shop_session + __Host-shop_csrf cookies set. Any guest cart was merged and its __Host-shop_cart cookie expired.

401.description: invalid_credentials — one response for every failure mode.

403.description: cross_origin_rejected — the Origin header names another site (login CSRF protection).

post.description: Destroy the shopper session (real revocation — the KV record is deleted, not just the cookie) and expire both shopper cookies. Requires the __Host-shop_csrf double-submit: echo the __Host-shop_csrf cookie's token in X-CSRF-Token.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: The __Host-shop_csrf cookie value (HMAC-bound to this session).

403.description: CSRF token missing, mismatched, or bound to a different session.

get.description: The signed-in shopper's own record (never password_hash).

post.description: Request a shopper password reset (storefront surface, cookie world — not for PATs). Always returns the same generic success whether or not the email belongs to a customer, so it cannot enumerate customer emails. Mints a single-use reset token valid for 1 hour, stored only as a SHA-256 hash; email delivery of the reset link ships in a later slice. Rate limited per IP and per (email, IP).

200.description: Generic success — identical for known and unknown emails.

post.description: Redeem a password-reset token and set a new password. The token is single-use; unknown, expired and already-used tokens return one identical 400. On success every existing shopper session for that customer is revoked and no new session is started — sign in at /api/shop/login with the new password. Rate limited per IP.

token.description: 64-char lowercase hex token from the reset link.

password.description: Min 8 chars with upper, lower and digit.

200.description: Password reset; all existing shopper sessions revoked. No cookies set.

400.description: Invalid, expired or already-used token, or weak password.

get.description: The current cart: the signed-in shopper's (__Host-shop_session) or the guest cart the __Host-shop_cart token resolves to on this store. Reading never creates a cart. Prices are live; lines whose product is no longer sellable come back with available:false and are excluded from subtotal.

200.description: The cart. id is null and items empty when none exists yet.

post.description: Add a product to the cart, creating the cart if needed — a guest's first add mints the __Host-shop_cart cookie. Adding a product already in the cart sums quantities (capped at 999). Signed-in requests must echo __Host-shop_csrf in X-CSRF-Token. Rate limited per IP; sustained abuse returns 429.

200.description: The updated cart. A new guest cart also sets the __Host-shop_cart cookie.

400.description: invalid_product_id / invalid_quantity — non-integer, zero, negative or absurd values.

403.description: CSRF_INVALID — signed-in write without a valid X-CSRF-Token.

404.description: product_not_found — missing, archived, hidden, other-store, off-currency (a product listed in a currency other than the cart's) and absurdly-priced products are indistinguishable.

patch.description: Set a cart line's quantity. The line must belong to the cart this request's own credentials resolve to — anyone else's line id returns the same 404 as a nonexistent one. Signed-in requests must echo __Host-shop_csrf in X-CSRF-Token.

404.description: item_not_found — no such line in YOUR cart.

delete.description: Remove a cart line. Same ownership rule as PATCH. Signed-in requests must echo __Host-shop_csrf in X-CSRF-Token.

404.description: item_not_found — no such line in YOUR cart.

post.description: Turn the current cart into an order. Guest checkout (__Host-shop_cart token) requires email and optionally name in the body and must be same-origin; the order's customer_id is null. Signed-in checkout (__Host-shop_session) must echo __Host-shop_csrf in X-CSRF-Token; contact fields come from the account and the body is ignored. Line items snapshot name and the live price at checkout; totals are computed server-side in integer minor units. The cart is consumed atomically (a guest's __Host-shop_cart cookie is cleared). Order status starts as pending_payment; payment itself ships in slice 3b. Rate limited per IP.

email.description: Required for guest checkout; ignored when signed in.

200.description: The order as placed: id, status pending_payment, currency, subtotal/total in minor units, and line items with snapshotted name, unit_price and line_total.

400.description: cart_empty (no cart, or nothing in it), invalid_email / invalid_name (guest fields), or an unknown field — client-supplied totals are rejected.

403.description: CSRF_INVALID (signed-in, bad or missing X-CSRF-Token) or cross_origin_rejected (guest POST from another origin).

409.description: cart_unavailable_items — the cart holds a line whose product is archived, hidden, off-currency or over the price ceiling; product_ids names them. Remove those lines and retry.

413.description: body_too_large — the declared Content-Length exceeds the 16KB shop-API body cap.

503.description: store_not_provisioned — the tenant's store row does not exist yet.

get.description: List the store’s categories, ordered by sort_order then name. Products reference these ids via /api/v1/products. Served by STORE tenants only (product: "store" from GET /api/store); a CMS tenant has no such route — the call returns 404 (or 401 when authentication fails first) and never store data. Authenticated with a store PAT; read-only tokens may only GET.

post.description: Create a category. name is required; slug defaults to a slug derived from name. Served by STORE tenants only (product: "store" from GET /api/store); a CMS tenant has no such route — the call returns 404 (or 401 when authentication fails first) and never store data. Authenticated with a store PAT; read-only tokens may only GET.

slug.description: Defaults to a slug derived from name. Must be unique across the store.

parent_id.description: Id of an existing category, or null for top level.

400.description: Missing name, or parent_id names no existing category

409.description: A category with this slug already exists

get.description: Fetch one category. Served by STORE tenants only (product: "store" from GET /api/store); a CMS tenant has no such route — the call returns 404 (or 401 when authentication fails first) and never store data. Authenticated with a store PAT; read-only tokens may only GET.

patch.description: Partial update; send only the fields to change. A category cannot be its own parent. Served by STORE tenants only (product: "store" from GET /api/store); a CMS tenant has no such route — the call returns 404 (or 401 when authentication fails first) and never store data. Authenticated with a store PAT; read-only tokens may only GET.

slug.description: Defaults to a slug derived from name. Must be unique across the store.

parent_id.description: Id of an existing category, or null for top level.

409.description: A category with this slug already exists

delete.description: Delete a category. Child categories are detached (parent_id set to null), not deleted; product–category links are removed. Served by STORE tenants only (product: "store" from GET /api/store); a CMS tenant has no such route — the call returns 404 (or 401 when authentication fails first) and never store data. Authenticated with a store PAT; read-only tokens may only GET.

get.description: List products, ordered by sort_order then name. By default only active, visible products are returned (the storefront view). ?status=draft|active|archived filters by status regardless of visibility, ?status=all removes the status filter, and ?category=<id> keeps only products in that category. Served by STORE tenants only (product: "store" from GET /api/store); a CMS tenant has no such route — the call returns 404 (or 401 when authentication fails first) and never store data. Authenticated with a store PAT; read-only tokens may only GET.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Omit for active + visible only. Any explicit value ignores visibility.

post.description: Create a product. name is required; slug defaults to a slug derived from name; status defaults to draft. Category membership is set through `categories` (array of category ids). Served by STORE tenants only (product: "store" from GET /api/store); a CMS tenant has no such route — the call returns 404 (or 401 when authentication fails first) and never store data. Authenticated with a store PAT; read-only tokens may only GET.

slug.description: Defaults to a slug derived from name. Must be unique across the store.

price.description: Non-negative integer minor units (1999 = 19.99). Floats and negatives are rejected with 400, never rounded.

compare_at_price.description: Non-negative integer minor units, or null.

currency.description: 3-letter uppercase ISO 4217 code. Anything else is a 400. Defaults to the owning store’s currency when omitted on create.

images.description: Array of image URLs (or a pre-encoded JSON string).

categories.description: Category ids. On PATCH this REPLACES the product’s membership (an empty array removes it from every category); omit the field to leave membership unchanged. An unknown id is a 400 and nothing is written.

400.description: Missing name, invalid price (must be a non-negative integer in minor units), or a categories id names no existing category

409.description: A product with this slug already exists

get.description: Fetch one product, any status. The row includes `categories`: the array of category ids the product belongs to. Served by STORE tenants only (product: "store" from GET /api/store); a CMS tenant has no such route — the call returns 404 (or 401 when authentication fails first) and never store data. Authenticated with a store PAT; read-only tokens may only GET.

patch.description: Partial update; send only the fields to change. Sending `categories` REPLACES the product’s category membership in one transaction — it is not merged, so an empty array clears it. Served by STORE tenants only (product: "store" from GET /api/store); a CMS tenant has no such route — the call returns 404 (or 401 when authentication fails first) and never store data. Authenticated with a store PAT; read-only tokens may only GET.

slug.description: Defaults to a slug derived from name. Must be unique across the store.

price.description: Non-negative integer minor units (1999 = 19.99). Floats and negatives are rejected with 400, never rounded.

compare_at_price.description: Non-negative integer minor units, or null.

currency.description: 3-letter uppercase ISO 4217 code. Anything else is a 400. Defaults to the owning store’s currency when omitted on create.

images.description: Array of image URLs (or a pre-encoded JSON string).

categories.description: Category ids. On PATCH this REPLACES the product’s membership (an empty array removes it from every category); omit the field to leave membership unchanged. An unknown id is a 400 and nothing is written.

400.description: Invalid field values (price must be a non-negative integer in minor units; a categories id must name an existing category)

409.description: A product with this slug already exists

delete.description: Delete a product. Its category-membership rows are removed with it; categories themselves are untouched. Served by STORE tenants only (product: "store" from GET /api/store); a CMS tenant has no such route — the call returns 404 (or 401 when authentication fails first) and never store data. Authenticated with a store PAT; read-only tokens may only GET.

get.description: List the store's orders, newest first (placed_at, then id, both descending). All statuses are returned by default — ?status= narrows to one. Paged: ?limit= (default 50, max 100) and ?offset=. Guest orders (customer_id null) are always included alongside account orders. Served by STORE tenants only; read-only tokens may GET. This surface is read-only in this release: there is no POST/PATCH — orders are created by shopper checkout and status transitions arrive later.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Omit (or pass all) for every status.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-100. Anything else is a 400.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Rows to skip. Negative is a 400.

get.description: One order with its line items. Items render from their purchase-time snapshots (name, unit_price) — later product edits never change them, and the totals are what was charged. Another store's order id is a plain 404. Read-only in this release.

Read the store's settings: the 15 fields of StoreSettings, exactly — identity, contact, currency/locale/timezone, tax and analytics. The tax fields (tax_enabled, tax_rate, tax_inclusive) and the analytics ids (google_analytics_id, facebook_pixel_id) are STORED but not yet applied: tax is applied at checkout in slices 3–4 and analytics are emitted by the storefront in slice 6 — do not report them as live behaviour. Served by STORE tenants with store data. On a CMS tenant the SAME path exists too: the CMS’s own /api/v1 mirror routes it to a different CMS resource, so a 200 here does not prove you are talking to a store — check GET /api/v1/users/me, whose `product` field names the product that answered. Authenticated with a store PAT; read-only tokens may only GET.

patch.description: Partial update; send only the fields to change. Only the 15 StoreSettings fields are writable — anything else in the body is ignored, not an error (id and slug can never be written). currency must be a 3-letter uppercase ISO 4217 code; tax_rate is a number 0-100; tax_enabled and tax_inclusive accept 0, 1, true or false (strings are a 400). A body with nothing updatable is a 400, not a no-op 200. The tax fields (tax_enabled, tax_rate, tax_inclusive) and the analytics ids (google_analytics_id, facebook_pixel_id) are STORED but not yet applied: tax is applied at checkout in slices 3–4 and analytics are emitted by the storefront in slice 6 — do not report them as live behaviour. Served by STORE tenants with store data. On a CMS tenant the SAME path exists too: the CMS’s own /api/v1 mirror routes it to a different CMS resource, so a 200 here does not prove you are talking to a store — check GET /api/v1/users/me, whose `product` field names the product that answered. Authenticated with a store PAT; read-only tokens may only GET.

tax_enabled.description: Stored only in this release; tax is applied at checkout (slices 3-4).

tax_rate.description: Percentage, 0-100. Stored only in this release; applied at checkout (slices 3-4).

tax_inclusive.description: Stored only in this release; applied at checkout (slices 3-4).

google_analytics_id.description: Stored only in this release; emitted by the storefront in slice 6.

facebook_pixel_id.description: Stored only in this release; emitted by the storefront in slice 6.

400.description: Invalid field value, or nothing updatable in the body

get.description: Uniform product discovery: BOTH products serve this path. Returns the caller's own user row (never includes credential columns) plus `readOnly` — true when authenticating with a read-only PAT — `authMethod` (`pat` or `session`), and `product` ("cms" or "store"), which tells you which sections of this API the tenant serves. Make it the first call of every session. On CMS tenants it is the /api/v1 mirror of /api/users/me, so PATCH /api/v1/users/me works there too — documented once at PATCH /api/users/me, like every CMS operation. On store tenants only this /api/v1 path exists, and only as GET: PATCH is a 404 (a read-only token is refused first with 403 read_only_token).

product.description: Which EdgePress product this tenant runs: "cms" (absent also means cms) or "store".

readOnly.description: True when the presented PAT is read-only.

patch.description: Update the caller's own user row. **CMS tenants only** — the v1 path mirrors PATCH /api/users/me on a CMS. Store tenants serve GET at this path but not PATCH, and return 404 not_found for it; see GET /api/store for the store tenant's profile.

404.description: Not found. Returned by store tenants, which do not support PATCH at this path.
